g.text: unique (doctorId, date, shiftId): a doctor is in one place per shift
unique (roomId, date, shiftId): a room hosts one doctor per shift
capacity used = appointments whose status is not CANCELLED
doctor, date and shift are fixed after creation (room and maxPatients can change)
unique (rosterEntryId, queueNumber); queue numbers are never reused
specialty, doctor, room, date and shift come from its RosterEntry
status changes only through the state machine (see 04-state-appointment)
Specialty, Room and User are deactivated
